rows.question: In the grand tapestry of Wyoming's cities, which city stands as the most populous, classified under the realms of 'High Population' or 'Low Population', while sharing whispers through the fences with the neighboring land of Colorado?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cities_normalized AS (
SELECT
  city.city_name AS city_name,
  CASE
    WHEN typeof(city.population) = 'integer' THEN city.population
    WHEN typeof(city.population) = 'text' AND trim(city.population) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN typeof(city.population) = 'text' AND city.population GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(city.population AS INTEGER)
  END AS population,
  city.state_name AS state_name,
  city.country_name AS country_name
FROM city
),
state_borders AS (
SELECT
  border_info.state_name AS state_name,
  border_info.border AS border
FROM border_info
),
wyoming_city_population_stats AS (
SELECT
  cn.state_name AS state_name,
  cn.city_name AS city_name,
  cn.population AS population,
  -- median per state: use aggregated percent_rank-ish via row numbers to compute median
  (SELECT avg(p1.population)
   FROM (
     SELECT population,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population) AS rn_asc,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population DESC) AS rn_desc
     FROM cities_normalized AS p
     WHERE p.state_name = cn.state_name
   ) AS p1
   WHERE p1.rn_asc = p1.rn_desc
      OR p1.rn_asc + 1 = p1.rn_desc
  ) AS state_median_population,
  (SELECT MAX(population) FROM cities_normalized AS m WHERE m.state_name = cn.state_name) AS state_max_population,
  (SELECT 1 + COUNT(*) FROM cities_normalized AS r WHERE r.state_name = cn.state_name AND (r.population > cn.population OR (r.population = cn.population AND r.city_name < cn.city_name))) AS population_rank_within_state
FROM cities_normalized AS cn
)
SELECT
  c.city_name AS city_name,
  c.population AS population,
  CASE
    WHEN w.population >= w.state_median_population THEN 'High Population'
    ELSE 'Low Population'
  END AS population_classification
FROM cities_normalized c
JOIN wyoming_city_population_stats w
  ON c.city_name = w.city_name
  AND c.state_name = w.state_name
JOIN state_borders b
  ON c.state_name = b.state_name
WHERE
  c.state_name = 'Wyoming'
  AND b.border = 'Colorado'
  AND c.population = w.state_max_population
ORDER BY population DESC
